content.text: How do I create a token on Sui?

First, set up your local Sui environment. Then write a Move module with a struct representing your token. You’ll implement a function to mint new tokens, ensuring it checks the necessary permissions. Check out the official Sui dev docs for a full example!
Any security tips for my smart contract?

Always validate input data, especially when transferring assets. Use Move’s strict type system to prevent overflows and double-check ownership logic. And never store private keys in your code—basic but crucial!
